visible_text: Q4移行計画の打ち合わせ

observation.happening: Google Calendar-like interface showing home dashboard with an active recording session for a meeting displayed prominently in pink.
observation.most_important: Current meeting state is visually differentiated via background color; next scheduled meetings are listed below with time and platform info.
observation.next_action: Continue meeting, view upcoming agenda, or open live notes.

097C.why: Functional and clear information hierarchy with good use of color to distinguish active state. Lacks distinctive design touches; resembles standard Google calendar interface.

visible_text: macOSを先に出すことに決めました

observation.happening: Meeting transcript detail view with structured categories (decisions, action items, memos, questions) cross-referenced with numbered footnotes to timestamps in right-side chat view.
observation.most_important: Bidirectional linking between categorized summary (left) and timestamped transcript (right) enables tracking decisions back to speakers.
observation.next_action: Review full transcript, edit categories, or share summary.

0A00.why: Well-structured information with effective cross-referencing system. Handles high text density without sacrificing readability, but design approach feels familiar to standard note-taking apps.

observation.happening: Live meeting transcript with AI-driven automatic categorization into decisions, action items, and questions. Playback controls at top; dual-pane layout with categorized summary left and timestamped transcript right.
observation.most_important: AI-assisted auto-classification of meeting content into actionable categories, with full timestamp traceability and expandable sections.
observation.next_action: Play/pause recording, ask AI about meeting content, review referenced materials.

0DD0.why: Combines intelligent auto-categorization with clean dual-pane architecture. Playback state, AI processing, and cross-references are all clear. The automatic meeting classification differentiates this from commodity note apps.

observation.happening: Dark overlay modal showing listening state for voice input. Blue dot indicator and waveform icon signal active audio capture.
observation.most_important: Minimal visual language reduces cognitive load during voice input; ESC affordance visible for exit.
observation.next_action: Speak or press ESC to cancel.

1078.why: Intentional minimalism for listening state. Single focal point, clear affordance, high calmness. Waiting states are often mishandled; this is polished and focused.

visible_text: Q4移行計画の打ち合わせ

observation.happening: Home dashboard showing time-aware greeting ('こんばんは' for evening), suggested action (start recording), upcoming meetings, and recent meeting details with metadata (participant count, decision/action counts).
observation.most_important: Contextual greeting and proactive call-to-action (start recording) adapt to time of day and user state.
observation.next_action: Begin new recording session or review recent meeting details.

11E0.why: Time-aware personalization is thoughtful, but overall layout and component choices remain familiar. Functionally solid but lacks distinctive visual identity compared to 0DD0.

visible_text: このメッセージを送ります？
明日の会議、資料を先に共有します。

observation.happening: Slack outbound message confirmation dialog in dark mode. Message preview shown; 'external' risk badge highlights that channel is external-facing.
observation.most_important: External-channel warning is visually prominent and linguistically precise ('外部に出る'), making risk explicit before send.
observation.next_action: Confirm send ('直し終える') or cancel ('やめる').

186F.why: Excellent risk-mitigation UX. External warning is immediate and unambiguous; confirmation language is decisive. Modal hierarchy and affordances are clear. This is how security warnings should look.
